metadata.ranking_policy: First k retrieved chunks, then first-occurrence source deduplication; supplied labels may be alternatives and are not exhaustive chunk relevance judgments.

hit.description: Source-label and optional gold-keyword hit among top-k chunks; relevance proxy only.

f1_at_k.description: Harmonic mean of source-label precision and recall proxies.

mrr.description: Reciprocal first labeled-source rank after first-occurrence deduplication within top-k chunks.

average_precision.description: Sum of precision at labeled-source ranks divided by supplied label count; truncated source AP proxy.

rows.question: What is the cabin baggage allowance for Economy?
rows.expected_answer: Economy cabin baggage allowance is 7 kg, with maximum dimensions of 55 x 38 x 22 cm.

rows.question: Can I carry a power bank in my hand baggage?
rows.expected_answer: You may carry one power bank per passenger, with a maximum capacity of 100 Wh and a clearly visible capacity rating, in cabin baggage only. It is prohibited in checked baggage. Do not use or charge it on board or store it in the overhead compartment; keep it accessible in the seat pocket or a bag under the seat in front.

rows.expected_answer: Online check-in is available up to 48 hours before the flight.

rows.question: What check-in options does Emirates offer?
How do I request a wheelchair?
rows.expected_answer: Contact your local Emirates office to request accessible travel or special assistance. Emirates will make every effort to accommodate your needs.

rows.question: Can I travel when pregnant?
What are the rules for travelling with infants?
rows.expected_answer: An infant under two may travel on an adult's lap using the infant seat-belt extension during taxiing, take-off, landing, turbulence and whenever the seat-belt sign is on. If assigned a seat without an approved car seat, the infant must still be secured on the adult's lap during those safety periods. Lap or bassinet infant tickets are discounted. Infants under seven days may travel only for emergency medical travel in incubators or when the mother travels on compassionate grounds. A passenger aged two or older must occupy a seat.

rows.question: Can I cancel my ticket and get a refund?
rows.expected_answer: Refund eligibility and amount depend on the ticket's fare conditions. Cancel through Manage Your Booking where applicable and complete the Refund Request Form. A cancellation charge may apply, only part of the fare may be refundable, and the ticket may be non-refundable once travel has started. Eligible refunds may be returned to the original payment card.
